subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

"A person who studies the origin and development of human societies and cultures."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Anthropologist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Anthropologist"** refers to a person who studies the origin, development, and cultural behaviors of human societies. (मानव विज्ञानी)

 
 
• **Example:** The anthropologist traveled to remote villages to study their unique cultural practices.
 
 
 
• An **"Anthropologist"** focuses on understanding human evolution, social norms, and cultural diversity through research and fieldwork. (मानव विज्ञान का अध्ययन करने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** Margaret Mead is a famous anthropologist known for her work on cultural anthropology.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Anthropologist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sociologist** (समाजशास्त्री): A person who studies the structure, development, and functioning of human society.

 
 
• **Example:** The sociologist analyzed the impact of social media on modern relationships.
 
 
 
• **Historian** (इतिहासकार): A person who studies and writes about the past, particularly human history.
 
 
• **Example:** The historian wrote a detailed account of the ancient Roman Empire.
 
 
 
• **Archaeologist** (पुरातत्ववेत्ता): A person who studies human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and analysis of artifacts.
 
 
• **Example:** The archaeologist discovered an ancient burial site in the desert.
 
 

181:Tb91,

The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Forbid)**.
